title: Notion advisory read: date and timeline corrected
what_changed: Date changed from 12 to 9 November (Notion advisory first published). The summary said Fireworks told Notion on 2 November; Notion says the 2 November notice concerned synthetic test data, and the customer-data incident was notified on 6 November and confirmed on 8 November. The breach date is now given as 23 October (BleepingComputer) and 24 October (SecurityWeek). Notion's advisory and BleepingComputer added; validation now corroborated.
